query:
SELECT MIN(opportunityName) as opportunityName, COUNT(*) as cnt, GROUP_CONCAT(id ORDER BY id) as ids, GROUP_CONCAT(IFNULL(opportunityId,'') ORDER BY id) as oppIds
FROM projects
GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(opportunityName))
HAVING cnt > 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 20;
